text.text_excerpt: Stumbled upon this place while checking out the French Market. We got a grilled cheese with salami, chutney, and onions and a "market special" with goat cheese, pickled beets, arugula, and a cilantro pesto. Both sandwiches were VERY good. The bread was buttery, crusty near the edges and chewy/dense in the middle, the cheese was great, and both were hot-pressed to meld all the flavors together. We definitely, definitely recommend both sandwiches. This place offers a nice change of pace from some of the other spots in the area offering things like "alligator on a stick" and we loved it!

Super awesome nice employees and their cheddar grilled cheese sandwiches are to.die.for. GNOM! I sat there and chowed tow pounds of shrimp and then ended up eating the entire grilled cheese because it was that good. Fresh bread! REAL cheese (and cheddar--not that American crap they call cheese). They also had different flavors of San Pellegrino which included the Blood Orange. SCORE! They have a small seating area so if you are lucky to stroll up when they aren't their usual super busy, grab a chair and get some grilled cheese so you know what I am talking about.

I had bookmarked Continental Provisions ahead of my NOLA visit, so I was excited when we passed it in the French Market. It hadn't been that long since lunch, so I knew I couldn't order one of their pretty grilled cheese sandwiches (ugh!), but I still wanted cheese. I requested a "chunk of cheese" that would be smooth and under $7. The super friendly staff member came back with a nice cut of manchego for $6.25. Woohoo! This was so nice to snack on at the hotel. Definitely will return on a future NOLA trip to try their grilled cheese concoctions!
